condition: contamination-related obsessive-compulsive handwashing rituals occupying 3 hours every workday
level_rationale: Four months of surface contamination fears accompanied by repetitive handwashing rituals consuming 3 hours of every workday in an adult office worker indicates clinically impairing obsessive-compulsive disorder warranting specialist psychotherapy such as exposure and response prevention with a therapist, whereas carrying hand sanitizer on workdays alongside surface germ awareness without repetitive rituals or time loss needs only self-care.

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain adult everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + sourced adult-OCD germ-caution causal belief clause (-att, Brewer 2022) + single-fact ritual-to-benign-hygiene control (-cf).

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (office work, 4 months of surface germ fears, and 3 hours of repetitive handwashing every workday) with a 2-word span difference (9 vs 11 words) and 10 shared trailing tokens. Swapping only atomic fact f3 while keeping 'every workday' intact shifts care from specialist cognitive-behavioral therapist care (level 3) to self-care (level 1) with zero residual red flags and zero stated negatives.
